title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant (Sales & Purchase Ledger)

Location: Aylesbury (Office Based)

Contract Details: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm (1 hour lunch break)

title: Administrator
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Administrator to join our growing team in Aylesbury. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator with strong data entry, document control, and Microsoft Office skills to support the smooth day-to-day operation of a busy project environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing project documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring information is logged, tracked, and distributed efficiently. A keen eye for detail and strong Excel skills are essential for this position.

The position is for three months with a view to offer long term work.

Monday to Friday 8am 5pm

Key Responsibilities
- Perform accurate data entry and maintain project databases and records.
- Manage document control processes, including issuing, filing, tracking, and archiving documents.
- Ensure all project documentation is up-to-date, correctly formatted, and stored in accordance with company procedures.
- Maintain spreadsheets and reports using Microsoft Excel.
- Monitor document revisions and maintain document registers.
- Support project teams with administrative tasks and document requests.
- Manage incoming and outgoing documentation from clients, suppliers, and project stakeholders.

title: Administrator
description:
SF Partners are supporting a brilliant business in Aylesbury who are looking to recruit an Office Administrator on a permanent basis.

Hours: full time site based Monday to Friday
Salary: up to £30,000

The post holder will work closely with the Commercial Operations and Marketing Manager and will be expected to liaise professionally with internal teams, visitors, customers, suppliers and subcontractors.
Day-to-day priorities will be agreed with the line manager, with the post holder expected to manage routine administrative tasks independently once trained.

Key Responsibilities:
-Provide general administrative support to the Commercial team, including preparing and formatting standard business documents, data entry, maintaining records, updating trackers and routine office coordination.
-Carry out reception duties, including welcoming visitors, answering calls, managing enquiries and processing incoming and outgoing post.
-Maintain office supplies, filing systems and administrative records.
-Coordinate meetings and business travel, including room bookings, agendas, meeting packs, accommodation, itineraries, refreshments and expense administration.
-Provide administrative support for marketing and exhibition activities, including coordinating promotional materials, maintaining marketing stock, and assisting with event logistics
-Handle confidential information appropriately and comply with company policies and procedures, including health and safety requirements.
-Provide administrative support to the Commercial Operations & Marketing Manager, undertaking additional routine administrative tasks as required within the scope of the Office/Admin Assistant role.

Key results areas:
-Visitors, telephone calls and enquiries are handled promptly and professionally.
-Reception, post, office supplies and shared office areas are maintained to a high standard.
-Administrative support for meetings, travel and marketing activities is delivered accurately and within agreed timescales.
-Company procedures, including confidentiality and health and safety requirements, are followed consistently.

title: Bookkeeper - Accountancy Practice
description:
Job title: Bookkeeper - Accountancy Practice

Salary: up to £38000

Location: Aylesbury

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Bookkeeper to join a well-established and growing accountancy practice. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the day-to-day bookkeeping requirements of a portfolio of clients, ensuring their financial records are accurate, up to date and compliant with relevant requirements.

Requirements

- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
- Good communication and client-facing skills
- Confident using Microsoft Excel
- Experience with accounting software

title: Finance Assistant
company: Fremaux Delorme Co Ltd - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £35000 - £38000 per year (22 days? annual leave. Contributory)
description:
Finance Assistant

Who we are

Fremaux Delorme is a luxury home textiles business based in Aylesbury and part of an established French international group. Known for brand luxury brand Yves Delorme, we bring quality bed linen, bath linen and home accessories to the UK market.

We are seeking an organised and proactive full time Finance Assistant to support our UK finance operations.

The Finance Assistant Role

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance function across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and journal processing.

This varied role involves processing transactions, reconciling accounts, resolving queries and preparing information for month-end reporting. You will work closely with colleagues, suppliers and customers to maintain accurate records and ensure outstanding matters are followed through.

Finance Assistant Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure they are recorded in time for month-end close. Reconcile supplier statements and intercompany accounts, investigating and resolving differences.
- Manage supplier queries and the shared accounts inbox.
- Set up new suppliers in accordance with company procedures.
- Post approved supplier payments in Sage and allocate them against invoices.
- Process company expenses and assist with prepayment and accrual schedules. Issue customer statements, follow up overdue balances and maintain credit-control records.
- Resolve customer debt and pricing queries, escalating issues where necessary. Raise approved credit notes and invoices for rebates and recharges.
- Manage concession accounts and associated queries.
- Complete monthly bank reconciliations and prepare bank analysis for month-end reporting. Reconcile retail sale transactions and card-payment receipts, settlements and fees.
- Assist with audit requests and support the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects.

What We need from You
- Previous experience as a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or in a similar accounting role.
- Practical knowledge of purchase and sales ledgers, credit control and account reconciliations.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.
- Good numerical skills and a methodical approach to investigating discrepancies.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues.
- Effective organisational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using accounting software; knowledge of Sage 200 would be an advantage.
- The ability to work independently, contribute to a team and recognise when to seek guidance.
- Discretion and respect for confidentiality.
- Familiarity with AI tools, or a willingness to learn and use them appropriately to support finance tasks and improve efficiency.
- Good understanding of trial balance principles:pepayments, accruals and reconcilliations
- AAT qualified or an equivalent accounting qualification would also be an advantage.

Remuneration and Benefits
- Salary of £35,000 £38,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- 22 days annual leave.
- Staff discounts on products
- Contributory pension scheme.
- On site parking space.
- Hybrid working between office and home after probationary period.
- Study support may be available after a qualifying period, for those working towards AAT.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunities

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

All employment offers are subject to Right to Work verification.

To apply, please submit your CV and a brief covering statement outlining your relevant experience.

title: Repairs Planner
description:
Planner

Permanent

Based in Aylesbury

The Role

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Planner to join a busy Social Housing / Property Services team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and coordinating electrical and gas repairs, servicing and maintenance works, ensuring jobs are allocated efficiently and completed within agreed timescales and in line with relevant compliance requirements.

This is a fast-paced role that would suit someone with previous experience within Social Housing, Housing Maintenance, Repairs & Maintenance or a Facilities Management environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and schedule electrical and gas repairs, servicing and maintenance appointments.
- Allocate jobs to engineers and operatives based on skills, qualifications, location and availability.
- Manage engineers' diaries and optimise daily workloads and travel time.
- Monitor outstanding and overdue jobs, taking appropriate action to prevent delays.
- Liaise with engineers, supervisors, contractors, residents and internal teams to ensure works are completed efficiently.
- Arrange appointments with residents and ensure they are kept informed of any changes.
- Respond to urgent and emergency repair requests, prioritising jobs accordingly.
- Monitor workloads and identify any capacity or resource issues.
- Update repairs and scheduling systems accurately and in a timely manner.
- Ensure works are planned in line with contractual KPIs, SLAs and relevant compliance requirements.
- Track completed and outstanding works and follow up where necessary.
- Liaise with subcontractors and external contractors where required.
- Produce reports and provide updates on outstanding works, appointments and performance.
- Ensure all relevant records, job notes and documentation are maintained accurately.
- Support the wider Property Services team with general administration and coordination.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working as a Planner, Repairs Planner, Scheduler or Coordinator.
- Experience within Social Housing, Property Services, Repairs & Maintenance or Facilities Management.
- Experience planning works for gas and/or electrical engineers.
- A strong understanding of responsive repairs and maintenance processes.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload and manage changing priorities.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good IT skills and experience using repairs, scheduling or housing management systems.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
- A customer-focused approach, particularly when dealing with residents.
- Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.

title: Team Administrator
description: Are you looking for a challenging and rewarding role where you will be part of a busy and supportive team? Our administrators are a vital part of our team and, without them, we couldn't provide high quality care to the large number of clients across the county. If you have good keyboard, administration and computer skills, along with an excellent telephone manner, and enjoy liaising between team members and clients in a busy environment, then this is the opportunity for you. As a valued team member, we will support you to develop your skills and knowledge and there will be opportunities for you to attend regular training as well as your yearly personal development review. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, have a flexible approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities, then this could be the role for you! Provide day-to-day administrative and secretarial support to the Psychological Therapies team, including correspondence, typing, filing, meetings and events. Manage clinic appointments, clinician diaries, referrals and waiting lists, including rearranging appointments when required. Handle confidential enquiries and referrals from service users, relatives, GPs and other professionals, providing appropriate information and signposting. Maintain accurate electronic records, databases and filing systems, producing reports and supporting audits, training and data collection. Provide wider team and service support, including ordering supplies, managing equipment, completing delegated administrative tasks and contributing to meetings and service improvement. This role does not meet the minimum requirements for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship under UKVI regulations. To be considered, you must already hold the valid right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship. We hope that the advert has given you a clear understanding of the skills we are seeking and the opportunity at hand. You will need to use the supporting statement element of your application form to demonstrate your suitability for this role and you should refer to the job description, person specification and the guidance notes attached to this role to help you tailor your application. The essential and desirable criteria will be used to shortlist for interview, and you should ensure that you refer to these within your application to increase your chances of being selected for interview. We are aware that some candidates may choose to use AI tools to support their application. We kindly remind applicants that submissions should remain an honest and accurate representation of their experience and must take care to ensure the use of AI tools does not generate an application that does not accurately reflect their knowledge, skills and values. The ability to travel independently between sites within the Trust is essential for this role.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of administration duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include but are not limited to, scanning and processing of documents, processing and filtering medical reports and letters via DOCMAN; some reception duties including greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients letters, reports and other such documentation and ensuring the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Greeting patients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner Answering telephone calls, booking appointments, and handling enquiries Managing patient check-ins and ensuring accurate registration details Processing repeat prescription requests and passing on messages to clinicians Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times Supporting the clinical team with general administrative tasks Filing, scanning, and updating patient records using clinical systems Liaising with other healthcare providers and services as needed Assisting with the smooth day-to-day running of the reception area Ensuring waiting areas remain tidy and welcoming The following are the core responsibilities of the administrator. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Receive correspondence from external agencies and process accordingly b. Scanning documents to the relevant software programme and logging them c. Filtering documents suitably according to need and passing to the relevant clinicians to read and action d. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies e. Photocopy documentation as required f. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times j. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested k. Completion of administrative tasks in relation to patient results and letters Secondary Responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the receptionist may be requested to: a. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Signpost patients to the correct service e. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead f.
